flags.title: Resect before PET-CT result or tissue diagnosis?
flags.concern: VATS resection was recommended in the same breath as ordering the PET-CT, so the surgical decision does not appear to depend on the PET result. The patient is a former smoker (quit about 7 years ago), and the nodule is smooth, 2 cm, with no emphysema. Benign causes were acknowledged.
flags.consider: Consider reviewing the PET-CT result and a formal malignancy risk estimate first, and discussing the options (surveillance, image-guided biopsy, or resection with frozen section) at a multidisciplinary review before committing to surgery.

flags.title: Is the nodule related to RA or methotrexate?

flags.consider: Consider adding RA-related and drug-related nodules and infection to the differential, and review how they might affect the PET interpretation and the need for surgery.
